Rank 15
Imbuement
Cooldown: 20 seconds
Lucky Hit: 33%
Imbue your weapons with frigid energies for 6 seconds. While Imbued, your Imbueable Skills deal Cold damage, Chill enemies for [103%] per hit, and Weaken enemies for 4 seconds.

Cold Imbued Skills cause enemies to become Vulnerable for 4 seconds. Cold Imbuement's Duration is increased by x [128%].

Rank 15
Subterfuge

Casting Dark Shroud increases your Dodge Chance by 50% for 2 seconds. While you have at least 1 active shadow from Dark Shroud, gain [15.9%] Dodge Chance.
